questions.objective: Urgent HIV PEP evaluation after a qualifying recent exposure
questions.support: CDC says PEP should begin as soon as possible when indicated, without waiting for all test results, and is not recommended after more than 72 hours.

questions.objective: HCV RNA confirmation after reactive antibody testing
